What the hell are you doing?!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Zoidberg! We know about your secret agreement. I am so, so sorry for how we treated you.
Look, friends! I accidentally learned to tap-dance!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Zoidberg, I'm trying to—
Leela. Me saving things the leech. Not the eating of it.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Zoidberg, I'm very surprised at you, slightly.
The shame is too great. It's time to end this! Huh-yah! Feh!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Zoidberg, stop! We are too scared right now to enjoy the ceremony of your death!
Wait! People of Earth, listen. Yes, I'm desecrating a flag. But to preserve the freedom it represents!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Zoidberg, you set us free! I feel like I could stand to hug you! I can't, but you know what I'm trying to say.
Oy. I lost another one.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Zoidberg... I'm sorry to break it to you this way, but we hate you and we never wanna see you again.
Gumbercules? I love that guy!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: It's that jerk from the truck stop! Let's cross the street and try to blend in with that crowd of pimps.
Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: This isn't heaven. It just looks exactly like it, and makes us immortal, which I find suspicious.
Later, if anyone asks when I got away, tell them right now!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Forget it, Zookeeper! You're going into captivity.
Our transaction is complete. Come, Solomon. To the lair.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Mom! Dad! Oh, I'm so sorry I got you kidnapped by a crazy madman who tried to feed you to piranhas.
Fool! A quip about putting me behind bars would have been far more delicious. Here, catch!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No, Fry! You can't fall fast enough!
Sorry I'm late. Long story. Now everybody hit the deck! I'm cutting the entire line and stealing the exhibit.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You're not stealing anything! Nobody hit the deck!
The last human ghost. But robot ghosts?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: 0101100101. What does it mean?
Bigger! Bigger!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: A fashionable tank top. And designer boots... encrusted with jewels.
When I grow up, I wanna be a steam shovel!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: According to this, the Fountain is located in the darkest, most ancient region of space, just past Teddy Bear Junction.
When will Man learn that all races are equally inferior to robots?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Ah, here we are. The worst player in history. If I can be just a little better than him I can slink away with my head held high.
No! Oh, they're tormenting me with up-tempo singing and dancing.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Alright, Beelzebot, what'll it take to get our friend back?
Hey, Leela. Bubblegum might let me organise a bake sale for the Globetrotter wives. Can you teach me to make cupcakes?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Alright, but I wanna lick the beaters.
Yeah?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Alright, this is the third hose fight I've broken up today and the second one using actual hoses. Now move your lazy asses and start scrubbing the ship like I ordered you to.
One thing she can do is lodge a ball in the depth centre of your brain. You better get a batting helmet.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Alright. Low and away.
Thare she blows!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Alright. Which of you space dogs has the guts and know-how to harpoon that whale?
Oh, no! I forgot this is a hoverbridge.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: And I forgot this isn't a hovercar.
Ah!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: And, Bender, that aerosol head spray makes your antenna smell nice--
Look at these swanky tombs! These people really know how to die.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Are you crazy? They worked thousands of people to death to make these stupid monuments.
Aw, jeez with this, hey?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Arguably, this could be a good thing. The planet has returned to its primeval state.
One hundred dollars.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: As a pitcher, I serve up plenty of bean balls. So I know good beans when I see them. Bean-Bay Beans They're the beaniest!
Of course not. Filthy ice rats! Scat! Shoo! Gah! What are you doing? Get away!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Aw! They love you!
Damn you, old man!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Aw, look. Betsy followed you, Kif!
Let's get drunk!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Aww, thanks, guys. Pass the veal, please.
Ugh. You are the worst kind of rich person.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Be it parsnips or peppers or kale or zucchini.
My dumping business is booming. I just got hired to clean up the set of Free Willy 3.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender! Cut it out! First of all, the sewer mutants will be mad. Second, everything else that's horribly wrong with what you're doing!
No, of course not! It was... uh... porno! Yeah, that's it!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender! I didn't know you liked cooking! That's so cute!
Aw, they're so cute and harmless. No wonder you feel safe rippin' off their act.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender! I feel bad enough already.
Congratulations, Fry, you snagged the perfect girlfriend. Amy's rich, she's probably got other characteristics.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender! Romance isn't about money.
Why not, indeed?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender! Ship! Stop bickering or I'm gonna come back there and change your opinions manually.
Hey, what about this?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, I thought you were supposed to be cooking for this party.
Please, just leave me alone.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, I understand your desire to be remembered. But you don't need a statue for that.
Ah, can't beat fresh-squeezed!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, can you at least pretend you're being punished? And clean the black parts too.
Let's find out.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, do you know what a chamber pot is?
Ah, good. I often have thoughts and feelings that can only be expressed through dance. You stink. Bender's great. Deal with it.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, quick! Waggle something!
Come on, guys. Pharaoh's countin' on us. Work faster, like this. You call that motivating me? Don't just whip with your arms. The power comes from your hips. Like this.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, quit giving the slave drivers pointers!
Eh, the Professor's was better.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, shush. You're supposed to be dead.
Hm, words I never say. Oh, I know! "Thanks"!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, stop trying to destroy the world.
Garbage, huh? I'll take care of it.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, stop! It's a baby!
Hello, losers!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, thank God you're here. Talk some sense into the other machines.
Quiet, call coming in. Yes? A big endorsement deal for Leela? How much? Hey! You put a one and two zeroes in front of that or we pass! Deal!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, that's great! How much did you get me?
Humans dating robots is sick. You people wonder why I'm still single? It's 'cause all the fine robot sisters are dating humans!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, this is Fry's decision... and he made it wrong. So it's time for us to interfere in his life.
Ah, computer dating. It's like pimping but you rarely have to use the phrase "upside your head".

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, this is stupid. Why would anyone come to you for romantic help?
What?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, we didn't mind your drinking, or your kleptomania, or your pornography ring.
Guys, look. It's Calculon. And the Robot Devil! And an open bar! What's not to sneak into?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, you can't crash a mob wedding.
Whoa! This is awesome!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, you drank and smoked when you were a robot.
Alright, Amy, you win! The mob did it. I saw the whole thing while also having hot sex with the Donbot's daughter. I'm scared and great at sex!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender, you need to go to the police and tell them a tastefully edited version of what you just said.
More like three lockers and a sink!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender? Did you have something to do with this?
My roommate's gone. And all he left behind was an eyelash and three skin flakes. Oh, what's the point?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Bender? My God, you're a mess!
What is the world coming to? That Fry's a sicko poivert, I tell you. Dating a robot! It's an atrosmacy!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: But Fry's our friend, Bender.
I hate him.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: But he's just a tool to make your life easier. Like a socket wrench or a burglar's kit.
She's gone.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: But she saved all our lives. Without her, we're light enough to get away.
Time is money, peaches. Now shut your com link and make love to the camera. And remember I'm the camera. Stop actually washin' and play with the sponges!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: But the ship is dirty.
He's a saint!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: But why did you have all five weddings on the same day?
C'mon, Fry, I really wanna see it. You know how I yearn for a simpler time. A time of barn dances and buggy rides, before life was cheapened by heartless hi-tech machines.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: But, Bender, you are--
You got it, genius.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: But, didn't I do a good job?
There's gas in our ass.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Can you believe the price of dark matter? It'd be cheaper to fill the tank with Nobel Prize winners' sperm.
Well, we're boned!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Can't we get away in the ship?
Aw! Its anus looks like an asterisk.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Captain Fuzzytoes reporting for duty. I mean, cutie.
Yep, everything worked out great thanks to good old Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Come on! It's not like you intentionally set us up with bad dates so we'd spend Valentine's Day together.
Uh-oh.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Continuing my confession, this is the hardest thing I've ever done.
Scuse me, comin' through. Freedom train, step aside. You too, fatso. Freedom!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Cool your jowls, Nixon. You may not like it that Dr. Zoidberg desecrated a flag. You might even find the image of it festering in his bowels somehow offensive. But the right to freedom of expression is guaranteed by the Earth Constitution.
So, Leela, you must have had your pick of the litter last night at closing time.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Could you guys please stop talking about my personal life?
I don't even know what we do. Nah, just kidding! What are, like, a bus or something?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Did you approve that awful ad, Fry?
I wanted to watch you remember me.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Did you really think you'd need all this junk in the afterlife?
Who wants dolphin?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Dolphin? But dolphins are intelligent.
Do a flip!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Don't do it, Hermes! You have so much to live for.

Look, hoss, your wife threw you out. That's your license to be a jerk. Do whatever the hell you want then walk away and light a cigar. [He pulls a cigar out of his chest cabinet, lights it, and walks away.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Don't listen to him, Lrrr. Bender may seem happy. But in the long-tern, you need to reinvest in your relationship with Ndnd.
I'm gettin' on the bus!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Don't worry! I'll be fine! They know something about me and I've got to find out what. The lake didn't mutate me. What is going on here?
A what kind of disturbance?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Electrical. Anyway, it's going to take some careful piloting to avoid it.
Right on, sister. We should be back at Planet Express right now. Hiding from work in the ceiling. But no!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: For the last time, I'm not obsessed. I just want this whale to die, die, die!
Oh, so it's just coincidence that Zoidberg here is desperately poor and miserably lonely? Puh-lease!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: For your information, it's because he's hideous.
But we just had jobs!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Fortunately, I still have our old career chips.
Make Bender take a nap in a tube. Come back when I've had some sleep, baby!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Fry to battlestations. Fire torpedo number three.
Hello? Is anyone still alive? How about in the porno theatre? Don't be embarrassed. They're dead. All dead. Who would have known playing God could have such terrible consequences?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Fry, if I drop dead from exhaustion, make sure my body freezes in a dignified position. None of that "huddled over for warmth" crap.
Hey, All My Circuits! Move over.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Fry, sometimes in close quarters, people do inconsiderate things without realising it.
OK Mmm! Shorts!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Fry, this stuff was garbage when it was new. Let's blow it up already!
I said scram, grapey!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Fry? What are you doing.
You can't hit what you can't see!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Get up, Bender. You can't quit every time you get an axe in the back. Or a drill through your face. Now quit scratching your axe-hole and get out there.
I found a pair of hermaphlamingos.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Good. That's the last species.
It's a darn shame.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: He must have jumped ship with the atom the second we landed.
I know. But I just missed Nibbler so much.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: He was so cute.
That's right, we want some money— Wait. What's this about Fry?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: He's a nice guy but we think it's about time he got his own place.
Anyone seen Ulysses Grant? He owes me a cheroot.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: He's over there, pukin' in the Bushes.
A grim day for robot-kind. Ah, but we can always build more Killbots!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: He's the most decorated captain in the whole Democratic Order of Planets.
Ooh!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Heirloom eggs?! That's so life-affirming! I'll bet you run your own hatchery. Just you and your wife... Matilda.
Ow! Oh, my God! Ow!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Here you go. Hot off the nebula.
Aw! Here's a little song I wrote to cheer you up. It's called, Let's go already!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Here's to Amy, single, lonely, and fabulous.
Oh so just 'cause a robot wants to kill humans that makes him a radical?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hey hold on. I understand these robots hate humans but how do they feel about humanoid aliens?
I just wanted to be part of the moment.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hey! He stole my ring!
What? Drinking wine is a sin. Even if it is deliciously fortified.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hey, Bender, look at that woman's purse. It's hanging by a spaghetti strand.
Aww. You know what always cheers me up? Laughing at other people's misfortunes.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hey, guys. You missed a great delivery to Space Earth. Where you been all afternoon?
Yeah, yeah. Either one's fine.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hey, have you seen Fry?
Baby wants a Zima!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hey, hey! We can all fight when we're drunk. Now, listen, why don't we just brew our own beer?
Hey! Don't look at me like that. If you're thinking of crossing the line with Bender, you can forget it. Bender don't bend that way.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hey, look. It's another Lucy Liubot.
And try one of these Popsicle sticks. They've absorbed quite a bit of flavour.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hey, look. It's our old group picture.
It's gonna blow!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hey, watch it! You'll put somebody's eye out!
Hello? Imperial Dragon Restaurant? I've got a herd of you-know-whats for sale. Let me check. Oh, aren't you a cutie? About 35lbs. What?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hi, Bender. We'd like to adopt a child.
So this guy just unloaded a steaming pile of starship fuel?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: His species must've filled the entire planet with it. Did you do that, you cute little-- Come on. That should be more than enough fuel to get us outta here. Bender, pick it up and put it in the engine.
What are you, blind? It looks more like a hole full of fried prawns.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hm. This thing I wear on my wrist says they're not poisonous.
I'll try to keep that in mind!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hmm, he seems pretty angry.
Precocious little scamp, ain't I?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hmm. Bender must have a pent-up need to bend that's not being satisfied by his bend-free lifestyle.
It's like fine cognac with a hint of aged scrotum.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: How can this be? I thought the Benders drank all the alcohol in the world!
Those marvellous scammers sure scammed us, huh?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: How can you just sit there kissing the aliens' butt flaps? Don't you realize you are totally under their control?
Aye aye, Captain. It appears that Flexo has outwitted us all. Especially me... Bender.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: How could Flexo have stolen the atom?
And I'd do it again. And perhaps a third time. But that would be it. When we kiss, I feel like I'm standing waist-deep in a pool of cold, rising water.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Hurry! The escape pods should be just ahead!
Hey, I could have done that if you'd asked me.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I asked you five minutes ago.
Go, man! Go!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I can be really impulsive. It just takes me a while. Alright, Professor! Let's do it. Make that machine show me what would happen if I was a little more impulsive. Just a little. Not too much.
Ooh! You go, mutant girl!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I do go! He's a very important man.
You do? Look, are you going to help or not?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I don't know why I should. I mean after what he--
Sorry. Well, that solves the mystery of the missing ring. This calls for a drink.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I don't wanna spoil the party but we're all job deserters now. We're unemployed and we have nowhere to go.
Ow! Ow! Ow!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I heard you from my room. What's wrong?
And that's the story of how one of me became two and two became four, makin' seven total. The end.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I just like having the end locker. It's not like Amy cares about it at all. But no, she won't trade with me.
Yeah! We're gonna kick it up a notch. Bam!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I know you like cooking shows but you're a robot, you don't even have a sense of taste.
Yeah, good luck with that.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I must say, Hermes, you've got a smoking-hot body.
A little? You're screwier than my Aunt Rita. And she's a screw!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I need to calm down. I'd better take some more of that space honey.
Ooh! Ooh! Name it after me!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I think it's moving.
Some breaking occurred, the dolly was involved, that's about all we know.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I told you dumb apes not to overload it. Each of those pillows weighs 150lbs here.
No, I was telling you not to worry. I'm not allowed to sing. Court order.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I'll find Fry's coffin, get his corpse and keep it under my mattress to remind me that he's really dead. That'll prove I'm not insane.
OK, we won't eat you.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I'll go get some more bricks.
Alright, show's over. No refunds. You heard the robot. Get out!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I'm a fool. The fans haven't been cheering for me, they've been cheering at me.
Oh, yeah? I once caught a fish this big!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I'm afraid you're both out of your league, boys, 'cause you're looking at a woman who owns her own harpoon.
Not until I hunt down Inspector 5 and beat an explanation out of him!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I'm all for a good beating, but you'll never find him. Product inspectors are bureaucrats, faceless bean counters who blend into the woodwork.
What to do, what to do? One $300 hookerbot or 300 $1 hookerbots?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I'm going to swim with a whale. They're the gentle giants of the deep.
Happy. I like this feeling. Just don't revert to your usual mopey self.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I'm not mopey. You shut up!

Sure is shocking about the Professor, huh?. And now Hermes is mysteriously missing. Anyhow, it doesn't affect me, Bender. Hey, what's this? Hermes' dreadlocks? And his arm? Leela, I'm shocked. Food goes in the disposal, hair and flesh go in the trash!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, I couldn't stop-- W-Wait. Don't you care that I murdered Hermes?
It's too risky. I'm a very meek individual. If her personality engulfs mine, the Bender you know and worship could disappear forever!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I'm willing to take that risk.
Yes, I am. Having just this minute regained consciousness.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I've got an idea. Hold still. It's about to break. Yes! Yes!
Forbidden shmer-shmidden! What are they gonna do, write a letter? Ooh, I'm so scared!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: I've lost control of the ship!
Let me put it like this. After I leave here, I'm getting a memory enema.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: If I may offer some constructive criticism, there was never any real peril. I mean, the delivery guy has, like, 30 superpowers.
Lay it on us, big boots.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: If the Smellescope can pick up the Professor's odour, we may have a chance to save him.
He means you guys did it.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: If you don't mind, we're here to deliver the scissors for the ribbon-cutting.
It's crooked!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: In the end though, it doesn't matter who my parents were. All that matters is what I learned here, within these unscalable walls, that I have strength to make it on my own, just like all of you kids here today.
What's this junk?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: It looks like... a timeline of my whole life.
Psst, there it is.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: It looks so unhappy. Excuse me? Are you Project Satan? Don't be afraid. We know what you are.
Ooh. Now this guy had taste!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: It says he was mummified in ceremonial vestments.
Why not?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: It sounds too much like those frozen rocky mountain oysters on a stick. You know, Test-cicles?
I tried to run you over?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: It was very sweet of you, Bender.
And this is just last year at Space Mardi Gras.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: It's like some kind of weird Leela museum... and I'm the Leela!
Nibbler?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: It's no use. We'd better turn back. Which way, Fry?
Hey, a friend of mine said he mugged you today and you had superpowers.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: It's true. Thanks to this funky-fresh cream.
El zilcho? Is it too late to change my superhero name?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Just be cool. Nobody knows we're super-powerly challenged.
What a dump!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Just like old times. Gosh! The bars on the windows seemed so much thicker back then. Mr. Vogel? Remember me?
Fine, we'll have rack of Nibbler.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Just make a simple cake. And this time, if someone's going to jump out of it, make sure you put them in after you cook it.
Roger that, I got a map of the ship right here.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Keep an eye on Fry. We can't rule out the possibility that he did it.
He's pending for a bending.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Leave him alone. It's not his fault that he's an unstoppable killing machine. Is it, snoogums?
Fry! Stop doing the right thing, you jerk!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Let Mom buy the company! We all wanna be filthy, stinking rich!
That's what she said!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Let's face it, you two have deep relationship problems that can't be solved by an aphrodisiac.
Eep!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Let's try him out. Robot 1-X, can you clean Nibbler's stanky litterbox?
So? I'm already super-strong. And my arms do this. Also I got this going.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Listen up, New New York There's a new group of superheroes in town! And we're--
Now for a dash of salt! Uh-oh!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Listen, this is Bender's first meal and he's a little sensitive. So let's be supportive, OK?
Eh.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Listen. We actually came down here to find our pet, Nibbler. He got flushed down the toilet.
Leave me alone!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Look at that five o'clock rust. You've been up all night not drinking, haven't you?
Too bad it's a dump.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Look at that statue. It's only got one eye.
Aw, jeez. Let's just pray I have the energy to get myself another beer. Oh, what is this, the Middle Ages?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Look at you guys. No offence, Fry, but you've become a fat sack of crap.
No.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: My parents! They're coming up from the sewers for a visit Sunday.
You about done?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Next time I'm keeping it.
It's one thing to win a fixed fight; there's dignity in that. But to lose? And in this atrocity? I can't do it! Leela, you gotta train me to win.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No way! If you wouldn't take my help when you didn't need it, why should I give it to you now when you do need it?
I'll start loading up the pillows.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No way, Jack. You disobeyed an order, so now you have to deliver all 40 pillows by hand.
There's a thought.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No! We don't need a war of the worlds.
Didn't I, Leela? Didn't I?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No! You didn't! You just corralled a bunch of stiffs at the bus station and pocketed our money!
Crippling pain? That's not covered by my insurance fraud! Count me out.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No! You've got to do it. I don't care how suicidal it is.
I'll get it with my trusty foot cups Stompy and Smashy.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No, don't kill it! We have to...
Stealin' is a form of creativity!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No, it isn't. Guys! Come on out!
High school gym renovations on schedule? What a load!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No, over here! Flying saucer captured!
No, a whole Bender-ful!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No. Only what we need. Stuff the ship!
I don't?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: No. You have your legacy as a brutal, tyrannical dictator, and that will outlive any monument.
Oh, yeah? Well bite my shiny metal-- Oh, nooo!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Nobody tell Fry I'm deaf. If he found out I couldn't hear his opera, it'd break his heart.
Yes Miss Leela, tote that space barge, lift that space bale.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Now we can't land on the surface because those robots will kill Fry and me, so we'll have to stay up here and lower you with the winch. And remember You don't know humans, you don't work for humans, and above all, you don't like humans!
I prefer two. That way we can still be a horse for Hallowe'en!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: OK, Bender has her distracted. Now I can shut down her brain by deactivating the carbonated logic matrix. I can't concentrate with this obnoxious candy in my face.
You killed Fry!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: OK, I'm insane! But I'm still sane enough to know it. The only time I feel alright is in my dreams, with you. Three spoonfuls. Then I can dream forever. One. Two Here goes. Goodbye, waking world.
Leela save me... and yourself, I guess... and my banjo. And Fry.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: OK, OK. We have one chance. Are you willing to do what I say as captain?
Too much work. Let's burn it and say we dumped it in the sewer.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: OK, if everyone's finished being stupid--
It is if you're a laser printer.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: OK, my turn to tell a ghost story. Once, there was this woman driving--

Blackmail" is such an ugly word. I prefer "extortion". The "X" makes it sound cool. Please, honey, I'm made of metal. Like you're really gonna hurt me with a-- Hey! What are you doing with that microwave?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: OK, that's it. No more killing! Next time you feel like killing just have a stick of gum. Now to dispose of the body.
Only Robanukah. The holiest two weeks on the robot calendar.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh come on Bender. Last month it was Robomadan and before that Robonzaa.
Screw that! I ain't no delivery boy! I'm the company's chef.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh! You're the chef, are you? Then why don't you make us something nice to eat?
Alright, alright! If it means that much to you, blow up my statue.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh, Bender! When did you come in? Hold still!
Friends, I've come to free you from your complicated lives. Free you from the "complicated" part I mean not the "lives" part.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh, Lord, he's made of wood! What now, Bender?
Woah, woah, woah! How come we get off for every dumb human holiday but not for robot holidays?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh, Lord, not Robanukah.
Yep. It's like I taught 'em If it ain't black and white, peck scratch and bite! Now to take off my tuxedo. Guys, it's me! Your lovable dictator! Uh-oh!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh, if only we had a toboggan.
A baby what? Ow!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh, it's just a card. From the orphanarium I grew up in.
Look, everyone loves killing people, but I don't wanna hurt my friends.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh, no! It's midnight.
No! You can't blow up my monument. I won't be remembered.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh, right, how selfish of me. We'll just stay here forever. Hey, Fry? Remember that robot "Bender"?
I said hit the hay!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh, they're all so adorable.
It's already 10 o'clock!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Oh, you're right. Tomorrow is the day we fight back.
Sounds like a plan! Guess I'll pass the time by lightin' up an El Jerko!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Okay! That's it! I need some air.
Hang on.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Okay, we've got shelter and just enough precious food to ward off starvation.
Never!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: One spoonful to calm me down. OK, I've got a pretty good calm going! Two spoonfuls to help me sleep. Uh-oh, still awake. I guess one more spoonful couldn't hurt. Oh, my gosh! I'd better get a sponge. Fry? Is that you? I don't need a sponge!
Learning is fun.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Ooh, ancient Wall Street.
Yeah, you are, you stole my body! Fry, Leela, you gotta help me!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Ordinarily I'd say no and lecture you on how this is your own fault for being such an idiot. But when a robotic Nixon is on the loose, we have a duty to take action. Idiot.
Ho, ho-- Ow!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Professor! Don't you remember what I told you?
Green Bluebird, this is Mr. Fabulous. We are go for cheesing it.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Professor! Hermes! Zoidberg! Uh...
What about in the gutter?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Professor, there is nothing wrong with robosexuality.
I said, "Wow chica wow wow".

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Professor, what's the matter.
I'll save me!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Quick, grab his footcups.
Aw! Look at the cute, little— I was gonna go yachting in those feet!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Relax, you babies. It's no different from stomping a puppy.
All that and a small wiener? This guy's got it goin' on.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Remember Don't show any reaction to his appearance.
Whoa! I'm not reading that crap. Summarise it in one word.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Sabotage. This is a normal L-unit. Without it, space travel is but the fevered dream of a madman.
Let's go already!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Setting Bachman turners to overdrive.
And hookers, don't forget hookers.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Shame on all of you. After everything we've been through together, do you really think Fry would-
As your agent, I have access to you at all times.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Since when are you my agent?
Me too. Me too. Jerk.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: So Flexo and Angle-ine had sex right there on the factory floor? Well, at least you got bending out of your system.
Uh... where?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: So my question is this What if I found my true home? Ow!
You're the best, babe! Hang on. Call comin' in. What's that? Hey! You put a one and two zeroes in front of that or we pass! Deal!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: So what did you get me?
She'll be riding six white horses when she comes, She'll be riding six white horses when she comes--

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: So, Fry, was the real moon anything like the moon you used to dream about?
Neat!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: So, Hank-- The bad Hank. Just how blowful were you?
I like turtles.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: So, if you're not sure if it's alive or dead, Poke it with a stick and lick the stick instead.
Why won't anyone help me?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: So, once more we meet again.
Wait for us!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Something's wrong. We're two metric tons overweight.
That's what makes it so nasty!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Still, given the chance, I'd give in to urges far more shocking.
But sweet girls aren't for you, eh? You hard-fighting, hard-farting, ugly, ugly son of a--

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Stop! Stop flattering me!
That's puffin talk. Now follow me!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Stop! Stop shooting! It's me, Leela.
You can brew your own beer?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Sure. The kids at the orphanarium used to do it all the time.
Oh, right. Leela's back. As if I care. Woo.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Thanks. It's so nice to wake up and see—
Capital idea, old sport. I say, get the hell off me!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: That guy sounds familiar.
And unlabeled booze! Wide-mouth too!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: That oughta keep those dopes occupied. I can guard the real box in peace now that no one's curious about it.
Whoa! Get a load of this average-looking guy!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: That's Adlai Atkins. I used to have kind of a crush on him.
Fry's right! Let's kill the Captain and order some strippers! Yeah, what he said. It's a mutiny led by Fry!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: That's enough insubordination, Mr. Fry!
Yes! In your face, Gorgak!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: That's it, Fry. As your captain I order you back to the ship. You are in way over your head.
No. I'm gonna be a stalker!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: That's not really a career. More of a felony.
Huh? What?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: That's not torpedo three. That's not torpedo three at all!
Hey, look, Leela, it's that idiotic windbag you slept with.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: The Earth is under attack. Can't we just forget about that?
Falcon, this is Blue Raven, the goose has nested. Repeat, the goose has nested. Hey, guess what you're accessories to?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: The sun, the sea air, good friends.
Stinking bureaucrats! I hate 'em.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Then again, you might be able to find Inspector 5 with the help of another seasoned bureaucrat.
Way to go, squishy!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: There goes my DNA. What a disgusting and beautiful process.
No, we're not, you little bed-wetter. Oops! I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: There it is! The Near-Death Star!
Cursed by his own hubris!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: There's a political debate on! Quick, change the channel!
I just know these things. I've got what they call gaydar.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: There's no such thing.
People, it's far, far worse than we thought; my fish got away.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: There. Good as new! Except we're three miles below the surface, we don't have any food and the ship won't work underwater.
They're not very heavy but you don't hear me not complaining.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: They're not heavy in here because we have an anti-grav pump. But once you get out on the surface the gravity will be very intense.
So sober, so weak...

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Things really worked out nicely this time.
Yeah.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: This coming-together of superstars really means a lot to you, doesn't it, Bender?
Just like titanium!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: This is all a big load. I was the one trying to save the Popplers. You were sucking them down like the fat hog you are and you were stepping on them for fun. You both should be in here instead of me.
I'm not looking!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: This is officer 1B-DI requesting back-up.
Float for your lives!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: This is the one place she can't hear us. Everyone just pretend to shower.
Uh, while you're at it, could you touch up this seam?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: This is unbelievable. The old Bender never would have taken us out to dinner.
Aw, mom! Do we hafta?!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: This is what I'm talkin' about! See all the dirt an' earwigs? That's the sign of healthy food.
Merry Xmas, kids!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: This wangs chun! After all the good we tried to do, Xmas turned out as rotten as ever.
But by far the most important thing is oil.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: To keep the lamp light burning or to help the latkes broil?
Well, time for this robot to get back to work.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Too bad it didn't work out with Mom, Professor.
Pay dirt! I got the clover! Plus his wedding ring. Sorry, ladies, I'm taken! Hey, Fry, you want me to smack the corpse up a little?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Uh, Bender, I think Fry needs a moment alone.
Thank you, and goodnight.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Uh, Professor, are we even allowed in the Forbidden Zone?
None of your business! Get off my back!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Uh-oh. There seems to be some sort of electrical disturbance in the Coalsack Nebula.
Come look, everyone. I just got the dearest presents for Mommy.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Very nice. Where'd you steal them?
Now they drank my booze?! They've gone too far!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Wait a second. All Benders are powered by alcohol!
My God. You stole all your ideas from those poor, innocent creatures and hogged all the credit?! I underestimated you.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Wait! I can explain.
Are you crazy? That's Little Bender you're talking about. I can't cut it off. You're not a robot or a man so you wouldn't understand. I gotta get out of here.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Wait! I want you to look me in the eye and promise you won't get behind the wheel without some kind of alcoholic beverage in your hand.
Um, uh, um. Ooh! Ow! He got me! Ooh! What a shot that guy is!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Wait! Why do the raised letters that normally say "Turn Master Steering Wheel Company" say "Nibbler"? Oh, no!
Well, that was rude.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Warden Vogel, I have a new story for the children. I'm sure they'll like it more than my last one.
It's a bluff!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We can't take that chance. Move, people, move!
Well, this is just great! What's the point of living if I can't say "ass"? Hey, I didn't blow up! Ass, ass, ass, ass, ass! Alright! I'm back in the saddle!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We couldn't disarm the bomb so we reset the word that triggers it.
Pardon me, brother. Care to donate to the Anti-Mugging-You Fund? Ow!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We don't need to beg, Bender. For God's sake, we're not veterans!
Better than usual!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We got medals! Good work, team! We really pulled together on this one.
So should we get our stuff and head down to the planet?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We just talked, OK?!
Hey, sexy mama, wanna kill all the humans?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We sure are cheerful this morning.

Wow! Crime-fighting. Cool. You say you're a duo? Yeah, duos are good. Of course sometimes they're a little short-handed. See you. With two humans, you'd think there'd be a robot in there to balance things out but whatever. I have these three costumes you could use. But I guess I'll just throw one away.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We'd love to have you on the team, Bender. But aren't you more on the supply side of crime?
All situations have the same Plan C. Bending, come on.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We're boned, Bender. It's a brick wall.
I'll go too, with Leonard's permission, of course.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We're entering the Omega system.
We live to suck another day!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We're just as good as any of those other crews you sent to their deaths. What's the mission?
Get lost! I'd say "Don't quit your day job" but you're awful at that too.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We're trying our best.
Fry, we've got to discuss your living arrangements.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: We've all talked it over and--
Oh, no room for Bender, huh? Fine! I'll go build my own lunar lander, with blackjack and hookers. In fact, forget the lunar lander and the blackjack. Ah, screw the whole thing.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well if the oxygen holds out we might live long enough to starve to death.
With my mighty robot powers, I can get sick of things much quicker than you humans.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well just remember we all still have to work together. So try and let her down easy.
Afterlife? Pft. If I thought I had to go through a whole other life I'd kill myself right now.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well rot in peace. Fry and I are leaving.
I can't. My Fembot may be in love with another Manbot.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well talk to her. Tell her about your feelings in an open an honest way.
Listen to me, Leela I'm an expert at not caring. The secret is to stop giving a rat's ass about anyone else and start thinking of the things that you want, that you deserve, that the world owes you.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well, I could use a new tank top.
She's a nervous wreck!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well, I may not have a man, but at least I've got you, poopsie-doodle.
I can't. I'm stuck in the can.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well, ask Robot 1-X to pull you out.
Like how? Having my antenna removed?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well, if that would work.
He was fun.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well, if we get bored looking for the clover, I've got Tetris on this thing.
So we're cool?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well, it was a spectacular battle but there doesn't seem to be any permanent damage.
Alright, take it. Sheesh!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well, looks like Flexo got away clean.
I'm her favourite.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Well, see you back at the office. And don't forget to tell your Mom you love her.
That's what it says on my vanity plate.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What about the sentries?
Mmm! Mmm! Fry, you're my friend! Come on, everyone line up for a hug. Let's tear down some emotional walls.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What are you doing to my ship?
Alright! I'm rich!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What are you talking about?
Citizens of Me! The cruelty of the old Pharaoh is a thing of the past. Let a whole new wave of cruelty wash over this lazy land.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What did he say?
Yeah, this past week with Fry's been a blast! Y'know, beneath this warm, sunny exterior beats the cold, mechanical heart of a robot.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What happened to you?
Not enough room? My place is two cubic metres and we only take up 1.5 cubic metres. We've got room for a-whole-nother two-thirds of a person.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What if I just helped the two of you find a bigger apartment?
The costume contest! The costume contest!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What the hell are you supposed to be?
Thank you!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What the hell were you doing? I warned you to stay away from those guys.
Oh, it's a turnstile.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What's this? Another bathroom?
Pretty annoying, huh, Leela?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What? Are you talking? Oh, God! I'm deaf!
Forget it, he's gay.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What? How can you tell?
Oops. I'm so, so sorry, Leela. I just wanted to annoy you.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: What? Oh, this is horrible. I won't be able to hear Fry's opera.
You know we don't!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Whoever did this was strong. This is 340 pounds of Tonka-tough steel.
C'mon, Fry. Get up!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Wow! The burial chamber of the 20th century's greatest spiritual leader, Al Sharpton.
Bender. Have you seen my body? I think the Professor's in it.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Yeah, he said something about running away. Then he ran away.
Are you familiar with my friend Al Gore? I'm tellin' you, losers get really desperate around Valentine's Day.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's pathetic alright! How much?
So musicians really Rodger your Hammerstein, huh?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Yeah, it's weird; Sean was uneducated, unambitious. He was pastey and hunched--
Don't stop now, you'll need some pants to go with that outfit.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Yeah. And I could afford it all if I didn't have to feed that stupid Nibbler.
And that's how I defeated Elzar, thanks to Spargle's magic liquid.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Yes, we were there. And we just finished watching it again on TV.
A thousand and one pesos!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Yo soy muy malo en lanzar, pero yo soy muy bueno en comer frijoles. Come los Bean Bay frijoles, los frijoles de los reyes.
But I'm Bender, king of the combination shot. I put you in so that by busting you out, I could commit 15 felonies at once. Puttin' my rap sheet miles ahead of yours on the all-time chart.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You are one devious bastard.
I think I got whiplash.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You can't have whiplash, you don't have a neck.
An' I left a trail of cigars!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You don't have to do this, Fry. Mr. Peppy just gave me a little love concussion.
You people are nuts. My antenna never interfered with my old TV.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You had cable. This is satellite.
Only one way to find out.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You have no sympathy for anyone else's feelings.
And I still barely felt anything. Goodnight, losers!

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You know, Bender may not have learned anything from me, but I think I actually learned something from him. So long, jerkwads!
I'm sick.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You poor baby. Let me check if you have a fever. Ow!
-Good comeback, Leela.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You shut up, too.
No. Nothing. Not at all. No way, José! Here it is.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You took this from Fry's locker?
Hey, look! There's a chapter of my old robot fraternity, Epsilon Rho Rho.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You went to college?
True. I've always dreamt of being an emperor. You know, for Halloween, and then forever. But heisting those jewels would be difficult.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You'd be stupid to try.
For one thing, we both have a tough outer shell. But lead a rich, inner life. And also... well, you know.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You're both alcoholic, whore-mongering, chain-smoking gamblers?
Ah, leave him alone, Leela. So he's going a little wacko with his money. It's OK.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You're just saying that because he bought you that antique robot toy.
You are. What about that little girl you visited in the hospital? You know the one I mean? The one who died?

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: You're right. I can't let people down anymore. As God as my witness, I vow to earn the respect of girls and women everywhere. I will become the best blernsball player of all time.
Nope, pubic library.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
dialogue.text: Zapp? Where are you? Oh, God, I'm actually starting to miss him.
Wait. In a minute.

dialogue.speaker: Leela
